title: Orrin Field Supply brand identity kit
deliverable: A brand kit for a fictional outdoor goods company: logo mark with horizontal, stacked and mono lockups; swatch and type system with light and dark tokens; 8 icons and 2 spot illustrations; print and screen exports; a guidelines PDF; one packaged folder.
status_rule: callable = a RUN_COMMANDS id, CLI verb, Viewer::shell_command leaf or public Viewer method that was read and can be called now. engine_only = public crate logic exists but no command or host reaches it. missing = searched and not found; agent_call.evidence names the search, which the build of this file re-ran with git grep at the revision and required to return nothing. Every file:line was resolved against that revision by the same build. Tests were not run: callable means present and read, not proven working. agent_call.reach separates a real command from a Rust-only Viewer method.
input_assets: Generated font fixture in the test-font manner, or the harness bundled face FontFile::bundled; no proprietary font
Hand-sketch PNG generated by the runner for the trace step
Synthetic spot colour book named ORRIN-TEST, no real ink library data
